claims: SpaceX successfully launched a Falcon 9 rocket carrying 25 Starlink satellites from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California on Monday, April 6, 2026, at 7:49 p.m. PDT (10:49 p.m. EDT).
The launch was visible across Southern California.
The 1st stage booster landed on a droneship in the Pacific Ocean.
The launch site was Space Launch Complex 4 East (SLC-4E) at Vandenberg Space Force Base, CA.
The 1st stage booster had tail number B1103.
The 1st stage booster made its 10th flight.
The replay of the launch is available on SpaceX's X account.
The flight was previously delayed from Sunday.
